::: {.home-lede}
The Craft of Computing is the first course for Information Sciences major and
minor students at Azim Premji University. It is a hands-on exploration of
computing: getting comfortable with the command line, learning Python, and
using sensors and microcontrollers to interact with the world outside the
screen.

[About this course](about.qmd){.home-lede-link}
:::

::: {.home-point}
### Built for beginners

Designed for absolute beginners. No prior programming experience or
familiarity with technical tools is required.
:::

::: {.home-point}
### Learn by doing

Each lesson combines clear explanations with examples you can try and problems
you can solve. You learn each idea by putting it to use.
:::

::: {.home-point}
### A strong foundation

Even if you have some experience, the course offers ideas and challenges that
deepen your understanding. The skills and habits you develop will support a
lifetime of learning in computing.
:::
